title: Where pipeline definitions live: three repositories, one Jenkins
subtitle: A seed job executes Job DSL from the central repository to create multibranch jobs. Each multibranch job reads the Jenkinsfile from its service repository, and the Jenkinsfile loads shared library code.

nodes.detail:
